instruction: Configure LibreOffice Writer to use Arial as the default font for paragraphs.

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting Arial as the default font for paragraph text in LibreOffice Writer settings. The evaluator checks the registrymodifications.xcu configuration file for the Standard font property. The custom metric function check_default_paragraph_font__74864ed1840d0adbce3a5793ada3d47f parses the XML config file and verifies the default paragraph font matches Arial.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly retrieves LibreOffice configuration file (registrymodifications.xcu) which is the proper location for default font settings
Metric function correctly parses XML with proper namespace handling and searches for the correct XPath: /org.openoffice.Office.Writer/DefaultFont with property name 'Standard'
Metric correctly receives 'rules' parameter directly (not 'expected.get(rules)') following framework convention for type='rule'
Complete instruction coverage - evaluator checks exactly what instruction requires (Arial as default paragraph font)
Expected value is semantically correct (font_name: Arial matches instruction)
Data flow is correct: getter extracts config file → metric parses XML → metric compares font name
Handles edge cases properly: missing file, XML parsing errors, missing property all return 0.0
No postconfig needed - configuration is persisted to disk automatically by LibreOffice
